{{Top|leg}}
The '''landing point''' was located on the continent of [[Tharak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. It was the remains of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], with a single runway. A [[transponder]] was buried beneath the ground that broadcast an intermittent signal, which was a variant of the accepted landing field signal recognized by [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Most starships visiting Fyodos landed at the landing point. It was usually guarded by several [[Fyodoi]], who patrolled it for ceremonial reasons.
